caption: The video captures a steady pour of red liquid into a clear glass of water, set against a solid black background. A hand holds an inverted squeeze bottle at the top of the frame, its white nozzle cap pointing downward while a partially legible label with red graphics faces the camera. From the nozzle a thin, continuous, slightly slanted stream of red liquid descends, unbroken across the entire excerpt, with a few tiny red droplets suspended in the air nearby. The stream strikes the water surface and feeds a growing cloud of red dye beneath it. As the clip progresses, this submerged plume enlarges and softens, developing a wispy, billowing tail that sinks and spreads through the clear water rather than moving as a solid mass. The hand, bottle, glass, and water line remain fixed in screen position, indicating a static camera and an unwavering pour. The dye cloud keeps accumulating and diffusing downward, still in the midst of forming when the excerpt ends.
relations: Inverted bottle nozzle emits a continuous thin red stream that descends into the water surface.
Stream impact feeds a submerged red dye plume that enlarges and diffuses downward through the clear water.
Hand, bottle, and glass stay fixed in screen position while the dye cloud keeps accumulating.
A few tiny red droplets remain suspended in the air beside the falling stream.
